title: Wire struct _pad fields have no alignment comments
description: What is unclear: _pad fields in crypto2dev_init_op, crypto2dev_sign_op, etc. have no comment explaining why the padding exists or what property it maintains. The IMPORTANT banner at wire.h:103-106 says never reorder fields, but does not explain which fields require which alignment. A contributor adding a field to crypto2dev_init_op won't know if removing _pad[4] at the end is safe. Worse: if they add a field without adjusting _pad to maintain struct size, the sizeof changes, all IOC_* codes silently change (they encode sizeof), and the port breaks against any kernel module built against the old sizes with no diagnostic. What would make it clear: a per-struct comment stating the total struct size (e.g., /* total: 208 bytes; must match kernel uapi */) and a wc_static_assert2 on sizeof(struct crypto2dev_init_op) == EXPECTED_SIZE.
